methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This article explores three approaches in use: mandated programs (Japan), incentive programs (Sweden), and market-based certification programs (United States)

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Comparative analysis of three national government programs promoting ISO 50001/EMS uptake (Japan mandatory Energy Conservation Law, Sweden incentive-based PFE, US market-based SEP). Government energy-policy focus; EnPI/EnB concepts (energy baselines, benchmark indices, energy performance normalized to production) appear only incidentally as program requirements, with no EnPI/EnB measurement model identified or characterised.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The authors examine each of these three approaches by taking an in-depth look at one real-world example

stage1.notes: Policy-program comparison, not a model paper. Continuous-process sector terms appear only in Japan's benchmark business-line list; expect FN-lexicon hit for human census.
